title: 用户次日留存率
description: 计算用户第一次刷题后第二天仍然刷题的比例。结果保留 3 位小数。
challenge: 先找到每位用户的首次刷题日期，再判断该用户是否在首次刷题的次日出现。次日没有记录的用户也必须保留在分母中。
hints: 用 MIN(date) 获取每个 device_id 的首次刷题日期。
将首次日期表 LEFT JOIN 回明细表，连接条件是 device_id 相等且 date = first_date + 1 天。
分子统计匹配到次日记录的用户，分母统计所有首刷用户。
solution:
WITH first_practice AS (
  SELECT device_id, MIN(date) AS first_date
  FROM question_practice_detail
  GROUP BY device_id
)
SELECT ROUND(
  COUNT(DISTINCT next_day.device_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT first_practice.device_id),
  3
) AS retention_rate
FROM first_practice
LEFT JOIN question_practice_detail AS next_day
  ON first_practice.device_id = next_day.device_id
  AND next_day.date = DATE_ADD(first_practice.first_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY);

explanationSteps.title: 找到每位用户的第一次刷题
explanationSteps.goal: 把多条刷题记录压缩为每位用户一行。
explanationSteps.detail: 按 device_id 分组，MIN(date) 就是该用户的 first_date。

explanationSteps.title: 连接次日刷题记录
explanationSteps.goal: 判断每位首刷用户在第二天是否再次出现。
explanationSteps.detail: 使用 LEFT JOIN 保留全部首刷用户。next_date 为 NULL 表示次日没有刷题。
explanationSteps.sql:
FROM first_practice f
LEFT JOIN question_practice_detail n
  ON f.device_id = n.device_id
 AND n.date = DATE_ADD(f.first_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

explanationSteps.title: 计算留存比例
explanationSteps.goal: 用次日留存用户数除以首刷用户总数。
explanationSteps.detail: 4 位首刷用户中有 2 位次日仍刷题，因此留存率为 2 / 4 = 0.500。
explanationSteps.sql: COUNT(DISTINCT next_day.device_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT first_practice.device_id)

explanationSteps.title: 最终 SQL
explanationSteps.goal: 组合首刷日期、次日连接与比例计算。
explanationSteps.detail: 完整解法如下。先理解每个中间表，再对照自己的写法。
explanationSteps.sql:
WITH first_practice AS (
  SELECT device_id, MIN(date) AS first_date
  FROM question_practice_detail
  GROUP BY device_id
)
SELECT ROUND(
  COUNT(DISTINCT next_day.device_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT first_practice.device_id),
  3
) AS retention_rate
FROM first_practice
LEFT JOIN question_practice_detail AS next_day
  ON first_practice.device_id = next_day.device_id
  AND next_day.date = DATE_ADD(first_practice.first_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY);

title: 购物中心未交易顾客
description: 找出访问购物中心但没有进行任何交易的顾客，以及他们未交易的访问次数。
challenge: 返回 customer_id 和 count_no_trans，结果按 customer_id 升序排列。
hints: 从 Visits 出发 LEFT JOIN Transactions。
transaction_id 为 NULL 的行就是未交易访问。
按 customer_id 分组后 COUNT(*)。
starterSql:
SELECT
  
FROM Visits AS v
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON v.visit_id = t.visit_id;
solution:
SELECT v.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS count_no_trans
FROM Visits AS v
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON v.visit_id = t.visit_id
WHERE t.transaction_id IS NULL
GROUP BY v.customer_id
ORDER BY v.customer_id;

explanationSteps.title: 保留所有访问记录
explanationSteps.goal: 把交易信息连接到每次访问，同时不能丢掉无交易访问。
explanationSteps.detail: LEFT JOIN 以 Visits 为左表；visit_id 4、6、7、8 没有匹配交易。

explanationSteps.title: 筛选未交易访问
explanationSteps.goal: 只留下没有任何交易匹配的访问。
explanationSteps.detail: 判断右表主键 transaction_id IS NULL。
explanationSteps.sql: WHERE t.transaction_id IS NULL

explanationSteps.title: 按顾客汇总次数
explanationSteps.goal: 统计每位顾客无交易的访问次数。
explanationSteps.detail: customer 54 有两次，其余各一次。
explanationSteps.sql: GROUP BY v.customer_id

explanationSteps.title: 最终 SQL
explanationSteps.goal: 组合连接、筛选和分组。
explanationSteps.detail: 完整解法如下。
explanationSteps.sql:
SELECT v.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS count_no_trans
FROM Visits AS v
LEFT JOIN Transactions AS t
  ON v.visit_id = t.visit_id
WHERE t.transaction_id IS NULL
GROUP BY v.customer_id
ORDER BY v.customer_id;

title: 只在春季销售的产品
description: 找出所有销售日期都在 2019 年第一季度（2019-01-01 至 2019-03-31）的产品。
challenge: 返回 product_id 和 product_name。只要某个产品存在一笔区间外销售，就不能入选。
hints: Product 与 Sales 按 product_id 连接。
对每个产品求 MIN(sale_date) 与 MAX(sale_date)。
在 HAVING 中同时限制最早和最晚日期。
starterSql:
SELECT
  
FROM Product AS p
JOIN Sales AS s
  ON p.product_id = s.product_id;
solution:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM Product AS p
JOIN Sales AS s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING MIN(s.sale_date) >= '2019-01-01'
   AND MAX(s.sale_date) <= '2019-03-31'
ORDER BY p.product_id;

explanationSteps.title: 连接产品与销售
explanationSteps.goal: 为每笔销售补充产品名称。
explanationSteps.detail: 使用 product_id 建立连接。
explanationSteps.sql: FROM Product p JOIN Sales s ON p.product_id = s.product_id

explanationSteps.title: 计算销售日期边界
explanationSteps.goal: 找出每个产品最早和最晚的销售日期。
explanationSteps.detail: 如果两个边界都在第一季度，所有销售自然都在第一季度。
explanationSteps.sql: GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name

explanationSteps.title: 用 HAVING 筛选分组
explanationSteps.goal: 排除存在区间外销售的产品。
explanationSteps.detail: G4 的最晚销售日期是 2019-06-02，因此被排除。
explanationSteps.sql:
HAVING MIN(s.sale_date) >= '2019-01-01'
   AND MAX(s.sale_date) <= '2019-03-31'

explanationSteps.title: 最终 SQL
explanationSteps.goal: 组合连接、分组和分组筛选。
explanationSteps.detail: 完整解法如下。
explanationSteps.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM Product AS p
JOIN Sales AS s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING MIN(s.sale_date) >= '2019-01-01'
   AND MAX(s.sale_date) <= '2019-03-31'
ORDER BY p.product_id;

title: 经理和下属统计
description: 找出有直属下属的经理，并统计每位经理的直属下属人数和直属下属平均年龄。
challenge: 返回 employee_id、name、reports_count 和 average_age，平均年龄四舍五入到整数。
hints: 同一张 Employees 表需要扮演经理和下属两种角色。
按经理字段分组，COUNT 与 AVG 作用于下属行。
starterSql:
SELECT
  
FROM Employees AS manager
JOIN Employees AS report
  ON manager.employee_id = report.reports_to;
solution:
SELECT
  manager.employee_id,
  manager.name,
  COUNT(report.employee_id) AS reports_count,
  ROUND(AVG(report.age)) AS average_age
FROM Employees AS manager
JOIN Employees AS report
  ON manager.employee_id = report.reports_to
GROUP BY manager.employee_id, manager.name
ORDER BY manager.employee_id;

explanationSteps.title: 为同一张表分配两个角色
explanationSteps.goal: manager 表示经理，report 表示直属下属。
explanationSteps.detail: 自连接不是特殊语法；它只是同一张表使用两次并赋予不同别名。
explanationSteps.sql:
FROM Employees manager
JOIN Employees report
  ON manager.employee_id = report.reports_to

explanationSteps.title: 按经理分组
explanationSteps.goal: 把同一经理的所有直属下属归为一组。
explanationSteps.detail: Hercy 的组有两行，Alice 的组有一行。
explanationSteps.sql: GROUP BY manager.employee_id, manager.name

explanationSteps.title: 计算人数与平均年龄
explanationSteps.goal: 对每个经理分组执行 COUNT 和 AVG。
explanationSteps.detail: ROUND(AVG(report.age)) 将 38.5 四舍五入为 39。
explanationSteps.sql: COUNT(report.employee_id), ROUND(AVG(report.age))

explanationSteps.title: 最终 SQL
explanationSteps.goal: 组合自连接与聚合。
explanationSteps.detail: 完整解法如下。
explanationSteps.sql:
SELECT
  manager.employee_id, manager.name,
  COUNT(report.employee_id) AS reports_count,
  ROUND(AVG(report.age)) AS average_age
FROM Employees AS manager
JOIN Employees AS report
  ON manager.employee_id = report.reports_to
GROUP BY manager.employee_id, manager.name
ORDER BY manager.employee_id;

title: 所有商品都购买的客户
description: 找出购买了 Product 表中所有商品的客户。
challenge: Customer 表中可能存在重复购买，不能让重复记录影响商品种类数。
hints: 用 COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) 避免重复购买造成误判。
HAVING 中用子查询取得商品总数。
starterSql:
SELECT customer_id
FROM Customer
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING
solution:
SELECT customer_id
FROM Customer
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Product
)
ORDER BY customer_id;

explanationSteps.title: 按客户归纳已购商品
explanationSteps.goal: 观察每位客户覆盖了哪些不同商品。
explanationSteps.detail: DISTINCT 会把 customer 1 的重复商品 6 只计算一次。
explanationSteps.sql:
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key)
FROM Customer
GROUP BY customer_id

explanationSteps.title: 计算商品总数
explanationSteps.goal: 建立“全部商品”的比较基准。
explanationSteps.detail: Product 表中共有 2 种商品。
explanationSteps.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Product

explanationSteps.title: 用 HAVING 比较两个计数
explanationSteps.goal: 保留已购种类数等于商品总数的客户。
explanationSteps.detail: customer 1 和 3 都覆盖了商品 5、6。
explanationSteps.sql: HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Product)

explanationSteps.title: 最终 SQL
explanationSteps.goal: 组合客户分组与子查询。
explanationSteps.detail: 完整解法如下。
explanationSteps.sql:
SELECT customer_id
FROM Customer
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Product
)
ORDER BY customer_id;

title: 每日累计利润
description: 计算每天的利润，以及截至当天为止的累计利润。
challenge: 同一天可能有多笔利润记录，需要先按天汇总，再在每日结果上计算运行总和。
hints: 第一层查询按 date 计算 daily_profit。
第二层查询对 daily_profit 使用 SUM() OVER。
窗口内按 date 排序，显式写 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW。
starterSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date, SUM(profit) AS daily_profit
  FROM daily_profits
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT
  
FROM daily;
solution:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date, SUM(profit) AS daily_profit
  FROM daily_profits
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT
  date,
  daily_profit,
  SUM(daily_profit) OVER (
    ORDER BY date
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_profit
FROM daily
ORDER BY date;

explanationSteps.title: 先计算每天利润
explanationSteps.goal: 把同一天的多笔记录合并为一行。
explanationSteps.detail: 窗口函数应作用于已经汇总好的每日粒度。
explanationSteps.sql:
SELECT date, SUM(profit) AS daily_profit
FROM daily_profits
GROUP BY date

explanationSteps.title: 定义窗口顺序
explanationSteps.goal: 让每一行看到从第一天到当天的所有行。
explanationSteps.detail: ORDER BY date 决定累加顺序；ROWS 子句明确窗口边界。
explanationSteps.sql:
OVER (
  ORDER BY date
  ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
)

explanationSteps.title: 计算运行总和
explanationSteps.goal: 为每天生成截至当天的累计利润。
explanationSteps.sql: SUM(daily_profit) OVER (...) AS cumulative_profit

explanationSteps.title: 最终 SQL
explanationSteps.goal: 组合每日聚合与窗口累计。
explanationSteps.detail: 完整解法如下。
explanationSteps.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date, SUM(profit) AS daily_profit
  FROM daily_profits
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT date, daily_profit,
  SUM(daily_profit) OVER (
    ORDER BY date
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_profit
FROM daily
ORDER BY date;
